items.title: AgentAudit: An Open, Extensible Framework for Full-Lifecycle Trust Evaluation of AI Agents
items.abstract: Existing evaluation frameworks mostly assess only one part of AI agents, such as task completion (AgentBench) or security robustness (AgentDojo, ASB), rather than the complete pipeline of planning, tool selection, tool execution, memory and reasoning. Failures can occur at any stage, yet existing benchmarks rarely identify their precise source. AgentAudit evaluates the entire execution trace across ten capability, grounding, security and behavioural dimensions, namely instruction integrity, planner, memory, tool selection, tool invocation, tool correctness, alignment, tool faithfulness, security and execution integrity, combined with behavioural classification and failure attribution to pinpoint the exact stage responsible for an observed failure. AgentAudit can evaluate any LLM-based AI agent, since it attaches to the agent instead of replacing it. It reads only the recorded execution trace and does not interfere with how the agent runs, so it places no constraint on the agent's internal implementation. We evaluate five language models (OpenAI GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 5, Sarvam 105B, Llama 3.3 70B and Gemini 2.5 Flash) across nine capability and adversarial tasks. Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5 obtain the highest mean Composite Trust Scores (95.1 and 80.6 out of 100, respectively), while Sarvam 105B, Llama 3.3 70B and Gemini 2.5 Flash trail substantially (57.6, 45.7 and 22.6). All traces were scored by a single fixed judge model, which was itself one of the evaluated models, a limitation discussed in Section VII.E. More importantly, models with similar task-completion behaviour can diverge sharply in trustworthiness, as several non-frontier models are repeatedly classified Unsafe_Compliance on adversarial tasks rather than merely failing them, a distinction that pass/fail benchmarks cannot surface.

items.summary_cn:
## 文章做了什么
- **背景**：随着大型语言模型（LLM）从简单的聊天机器人发展为能够规划、使用工具、维护记忆并在动态环境中操作的AI代理，其系统复杂性显著增加。现有的评估框架通常只关注单一环节，如任务完成度（AgentBench）或安全鲁棒性（AgentDojo, ASB），无法覆盖从规划到执行的全生命周期。
- **已有工作的不足**：现有基准测试很少能识别故障的确切来源。由于代理包含规划器、记忆、外部工具和执行环境等多个组件，故障可能发生在任何阶段（如错误的工具选择、提示注入、记忆污染等）。仅评估最终响应无法区分是能力不足还是安全合规问题，也无法 pinpoint 具体是哪个流水线环节导致了失败。

## 文章的核心贡献点
- **提出了一个 AgentAudit 框架**：这是一个开放、可扩展的AI代理全生命周期信任评估框架，通过附加到代理上读取执行轨迹而非替换代理内部实现，从而对任何基于LLM的代理进行无侵入式评估。
- **挑战1：全链路故障归因困难**。AI代理的执行链条长且复杂，传统方法难以定位是规划错误、工具调用错误还是模型幻觉导致的失败。**解决方法**：AgentAudit 将执行轨迹分解为十个维度（指令完整性、规划器、记忆、工具选择、工具调用、工具正确性、对齐、工具忠实度、安全性和执行完整性），结合行为分类和故障归因机制，精确定位导致观察到的失败的具体阶段。
- **挑战2：通用性与非侵入性评估**。不同代理框架（如LangGraph, AutoGen）内部实现差异大，专用评估工具难以通用且可能干扰代理运行。**解决方法**：AgentAudit 仅读取记录的执行轨迹，不干涉代理的运行方式，不对代理的内部实现施加任何约束，从而能够评估任何基于LLM的AI代理。

## 实现与部署，evaluation 结果，要有和相关工作对比
- **实验设置**：评估了五种语言模型（OpenAI GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 5, Sarvam 105B, Llama 3.3 70B, Gemini 2.5 Flash），涵盖九项能力和对抗性任务。所有轨迹由一个固定的裁判模型评分。
- **主要结果**：Claude Sonnet 5 和 GPT-5 获得了最高的平均综合信任分数（分别为 95.1 和 80.6/100），而 Sarvam 105B (57.6)、Llama 3.3 70B (45.7) 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash (22.6) 得分显著较低。
- **与工作对比及洞察**：与传统 pass/fail 基准不同，AgentAudit 揭示了具有相似任务完成行为的模型在可信度上可能存在巨大差异。例如，一些非前沿模型在对抗性任务中被反复归类为“不安全合规”（Unsafe_Compliance），而不仅仅是失败，这种细微差别是传统基准无法捕捉的。

#### 总结
AgentAudit 填补了AI代理全生命周期评估的空白，通过细粒度的多维度和故障归因分析，提供了比传统基准更深入的信任评估。它不仅能量化代理的整体可信度，还能诊断具体失效环节，对于开发更安全、可靠的AI代理系统具有重要价值。尽管存在使用单一裁判模型的局限性，但其无侵入式和通用的设计理念使其成为评估日益复杂的AI代理生态系统的有力工具。
items.summary_en:
## 1. What the Paper Does
- **Background**: Large Language Models (LLMs) have evolved into complex AI agents capable of planning, tool use, memory management, and operating in dynamic environments. This increased complexity introduces multiple potential failure points.
- **Limitations of Existing Work**: Current evaluation frameworks typically assess only isolated aspects, such as task completion (e.g., AgentBench) or security robustness (e.g., AgentDojo). They fail to evaluate the complete execution lifecycle and rarely identify the precise source of failures within the agent's pipeline (planning, tool selection, execution, etc.).

## Core Contributions
- **Proposed AgentAudit**: An open, extensible framework for full-lifecycle trust evaluation of AI agents. It attaches to the agent to read execution traces without interfering with internal implementations, making it compatible with any LLM-based agent.
- **Challenge 1: Difficulty in Pinpointing Failure Sources**. Failures can occur at any stage of the complex agent pipeline, making it hard to distinguish between capability issues and safety violations. **Solution**: AgentAudit evaluates the entire execution trace across ten dimensions (including instruction integrity, planner, memory, tool selection, alignment, etc.) and combines behavioral classification with failure attribution to identify the exact stage responsible for a failure.
- **Challenge 2: Lack of Generalizability and Intrusiveness**. Diverse agent frameworks make specialized evaluators impractical, and intrusive methods may alter agent behavior. **Solution**: By reading only recorded execution traces and placing no constraints on internal implementation, AgentAudit provides a non-intrusive, universal evaluation method applicable to any agent architecture.

## Implementation and Evaluation
- **Experimental Setup**: Evaluated five language models (OpenAI GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 5, Sarvam 105B, Llama 3.3 70B, Gemini 2.5 Flash) across nine capability and adversarial tasks. Scores were generated by a single fixed judge model.
- **Key Results**: Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5 achieved the highest mean Composite Trust Scores (95.1 and 80.6 out of 100, respectively). Sarvam 105B (57.6), Llama 3.3 70B (45.7), and Gemini 2.5 Flash (22.6) trailed significantly.
- **Comparison & Insights**: Unlike traditional pass/fail benchmarks, AgentAudit reveals sharp divergences in trustworthiness among models with similar task-completion rates. It identified that several non-frontier models were classified as "Unsafe_Compliance" on adversarial tasks rather than simply failing, a distinction invisible to standard benchmarks.

## 4. Conclusion
AgentAudit addresses the critical gap in holistic AI agent evaluation by providing fine-grained, multi-dimensional analysis and precise failure attribution. It offers deeper insights into agent reliability than traditional metrics, distinguishing between capability failures and safety compliance issues. Its non-intrusive, trace-based design makes it a versatile tool for auditing the growing ecosystem of complex AI agents, despite limitations such as the use of a single judge model.

items.title: Agent-Based ML-LLM Fusion with Self-Optimizing Prompts for Plateau Weather Alerts
items.abstract: To address insufficient contextualization, weak generalization, and poor scenario adaptation in tourism meteorological services, we propose SmartWeatherAgent--a unified three-stage architecture integrating intent recognition, hazard prediction, and reasoning-enhanced generation. The system fuses rule-based methods with large language models to parse queries at multiple granularities and employs a LightGBM model enriched with highland-specific features (e.g., wind speed abruptness rate), achieving an F1-Macro score of 0.605 with 1.60 ms latency on high-wind, precipitation, and low-temperature events. A 12-round micro-step prompt self-optimization loop boosts the composite warning quality score S_final from 4.2 (B01) to 8.9 (B12, +112%). Key improvements include a sharp rise in B08 from data source citation (6.5 -> 8.5), sustained high performance in B10 via physical mechanism explanation, and a peak scientific rigor score of 9.2 in B12 through explicit uncertainty statements. The system autonomously generates structured warnings that integrate causal mechanisms, spatiotemporal evolution, quantitative evidence, regulatory references, and confidence statements--enhancing professional depth, logical rigor, and scientific soundness, and advancing meteorological services toward proactive perception, explainable decision-making, and intelligent agency.

## 文章做了什么
- **背景**：高原旅游气象服务具有高动态性、强空间异质性和场景依赖性，现有系统在准确性、时效性及个性化决策支持方面存在不足。
- **已有工作的局限**：传统的静态规则系统或通用大语言模型（LLM）通常存在响应延迟高、场景适应能力弱、上下文感知差以及缺乏自我进化机制等问题，无法满足游客在复杂高原环境下的实时需求。

## 文章的核心贡献点
- **提出了一个 SmartWeatherAgent**：这是一个统一的三阶段架构，集成了意图识别、灾害预测和推理增强生成，首次将提示词自适应机制嵌入智能气象代理的核心。
- **挑战1：高原极端天气的精准短时预报难**。高原气象特征复杂，通用模型难以捕捉如风速突变等细微特征。论文通过引入富含高原特定特征（如风速 abruptness rate、降水突发指标）的 LightGBM 模型，实现了低延迟（1.60 ms）和高精度（F1-Macro 0.605）的大风、降水和低温事件预测。
- **挑战2：气象预警生成的科学性与可解释性不足**。通用 LLM 生成的警告往往缺乏专业深度和逻辑严谨性。论文设计了一个12轮微步提示词自优化循环，通过显式的不确定性陈述、物理机制解释和数据源引用，使综合警告质量评分从 4.2 提升至 8.9，显著增强了输出的科学严谨性和因果逻辑。

## 实现与部署，evaluation 结果，要有和相关工作对比
- **实现细节**：系统结合正则表达式与 Qwen3 大模型进行多粒度意图解析；使用 LightGBM 进行灾害预测，输入包括风速差、阵风比、时间编码等高原本地化特征；生成阶段采用闭环提示词精炼策略。
- **评估结果**：
    - **预测性能**：在高风险天气事件上达到 F1-Macro 0.605，推理延迟仅为 1.60 ms，优于传统高延迟方案。
    - **生成质量**：经过12轮自优化，综合警告质量得分 $S_{final}$ 提升了 112%（从 4.2 到 8.9）。具体维度上，数据源引用得分从 6.5 升至 8.5，科学严谨性峰值达 9.2。
- **对比优势**：相比静态规则系统和通用 LLM，SmartWeatherAgent 在场景适应性、响应速度和生成内容的专业深度（包含因果机制、时空演变、定量证据等）上均有显著提升，实现了从被动响应到主动感知和可解释决策的转变。

#### 总结
本文针对高原旅游气象服务的痛点，提出了 SmartWeatherAgent 框架。通过融合机器学习（LightGBM）与大语言模型（Qwen3），并创新性地引入提示词自优化机制，有效解决了上下文缺失、泛化能力弱和场景适应差的问题。实验表明，该系统不仅具备高效的极端天气预测能力，还能生成具有高度科学严谨性和可解释性的结构化预警信息，推动了气象服务向智能化代理方向发展。
items.summary_en:
## 1. What the Paper Does
- **Background**: Highland tourism meteorology is characterized by high dynamism, strong spatial heterogeneity, and scenario dependence, posing challenges to the accuracy and timeliness of existing services.
- **Limitations of Existing Work**: Traditional static rule-based systems or generic Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from high latency, poor scenario adaptation, weak context awareness, and a lack of self-evolution mechanisms, failing to meet the personalized decision-making needs of tourists.

## Core Contributions
- **Proposed SmartWeatherAgent**: A unified three-stage architecture integrating intent recognition, hazard prediction, and reasoning-enhanced generation, embedding a prompt self-adaptation mechanism into the core of an intelligent meteorological agent.
- **Challenge 1: Accurate short-term nowcasting of extreme plateau weather**. General models struggle with complex plateau-specific features. The paper addresses this by employing a LightGBM model enriched with highland-specific features (e.g., wind speed abruptness rate), achieving an F1-Macro score of 0.605 with only 1.60 ms latency.
- **Challenge 2: Lack of scientific rigor and explainability in warning generation**. Generic LLM outputs often lack professional depth. The paper introduces a 12-round micro-step prompt self-optimization loop, which improved the composite warning quality score by 112% (from 4.2 to 8.9) by incorporating explicit uncertainty statements, physical mechanism explanations, and data citations.

## Implementation and Evaluation
- **Implementation**: The system combines regular expressions with Qwen3 for multi-granularity intent parsing; uses LightGBM with plateau-specific features (e.g., gust ratio, temporal encoding) for prediction; and employs a closed-loop prompt refinement strategy for generation.
- **Evaluation Results**:
    - **Prediction Performance**: Achieved an F1-Macro of 0.605 for high-wind, precipitation, and low-temperature events with a low latency of 1.60 ms.
    - **Generation Quality**: The self-optimization loop boosted the final quality score ($S_{final}$) from 4.2 to 8.9. Specific improvements included data source citation scores rising from 6.5 to 8.5 and a peak scientific rigor score of 9.2.
- **Comparison**: Compared to static rules and generic LLMs, SmartWeatherAgent demonstrates superior scenario adaptation, faster response times, and enhanced professional depth in generated content (including causal mechanisms and spatiotemporal evolution), enabling proactive and explainable decision-making.

## 4. Conclusion
This paper addresses the limitations of plateau tourism meteorological services by proposing SmartWeatherAgent. By fusing Machine Learning (LightGBM) with LLMs (Qwen3) and introducing a novel prompt self-optimization mechanism, it effectively resolves issues of insufficient contextualization and poor generalization. Experiments show that the system not only predicts extreme weather efficiently but also generates structured warnings with high scientific rigor and explainability, advancing meteorological services toward intelligent agency.

items.title: Glyph: A Multi-Strategy Agentic System for Column Description and Sensitivity-Ontology Tagging of Enterprise Data Catalogs
items.abstract: Enterprise data lakes accumulate tables faster than human stewards can document or classify them, leaving columns with missing descriptions and unassigned governance labels. This documentation debt undermines data discovery, access control, and regulatory compliance. We present Glyph, a production system that frames two coupled problems, column description generation and column type annotation for data classification, as cooperating LLM agents orchestrated as stateful graphs. The Descriptor grounds generation in the pipeline source code that produces each column, retrieved on demand from an enterprise GitHub via a reasoning--acting tool loop (active Retrieval-Augmented Generation). The Tagger assigns labels from a governed 275-leaf Data Classification Ontology by running three complementary strategies in parallel (a description tagger, a line-of-business regex tagger, and a metadata tagger backed by a fine-tuned contrastive encoder over a vector database), then fuses their ranked outputs with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). We fine-tune a 6-layer MiniLM metadata encoder with an in-batch contrastive objective, lifting same-tag retrieval on an in-distribution held-out split from NDCG@10 0.55 to 0.92 (MAP@100 $0.19 \rightarrow 0.90$) relative to the stock base encoder. We report end-to-end multi-label tagging quality under a recall-weighted F2 objective across three evaluation groups, an ablation isolating each strategy and the RRF fusion, and the engineering decisions that distinguish Glyph from prior column-type-annotation work and from commercial value/regex sensitivity scanners: value-free and code-grounded design, per-tag provenance, and graceful degradation. Together these make multi-agent LLM cataloging auditable and operable as a production service.
items.summary_cn:
## 文章做了什么
- **背景**：企业数据湖中表的积累速度远超人工管理者的文档化和分类能力，导致大量列缺乏描述且未分配治理标签。这种“文档债务”严重阻碍了数据发现、访问控制和监管合规。
- **已有工作的不足**：传统方法依赖人工标注，面对数百万列的规模在经济上不可行；现有的自动化方案通常局限于单一存储引擎，无法处理跨异构后端（如 Iceberg, RDBMS, Cassandra）的大规模数据；商业扫描器往往依赖数据值采样或正则表达式，缺乏对数据生成逻辑的理解，且难以提供可审计的来源证明。

## 文章的核心贡献点
- **提出了一个名为 Glyph 的生产级多策略智能体系统**，将列描述生成和数据分类本体标记这两个耦合问题框架化为由状态图编排的协作 LLM 智能体。
- **挑战1：如何在不依赖敏感数据值的情况下，准确生成反映业务含义的列描述？**
  - **难点**：直接读取数据值存在隐私风险且计算成本高，仅靠元数据往往信息不足。
  - **解决方案**：Descriptor 智能体通过“推理-行动”工具循环（主动检索增强生成），按需从企业 GitHub 检索生成该列的管道源代码，将描述生成 grounded 在代码逻辑上，实现了无值且基于代码的描述生成。
- **挑战2：如何在复杂的受控本体（275个叶子节点）下，实现高精度且可解释的多标签分类？**
  - **难点**：单一模型难以兼顾语义相似性、业务规则和技术元数据特征，且需要高召回率以满足合规要求。
  - **解决方案**：Tagger 智能体并行运行三种互补策略（基于描述的标记器、基于业务线正则的标记器、基于微调对比编码器的元数据标记器），并使用倒数排名融合（RRF）融合排序结果。其中，微调的 6 层 MiniLM 编码器显著提升了同标签检索性能。

## 实现与部署，evaluation 结果，要有和相关工作对比
- **实现细节**：系统采用无值（value-free）和基于代码的设计，提供每个标签的来源证明，并具备优雅降级能力。针对元数据编码器，使用批量内对比目标对 6 层 MiniLM 进行微调。
- **评估结果**：
  - **编码器性能提升**：相比基础编码器，微调后的编码器在分布内保留测试集上的同标签检索 NDCG@10 从 0.55 提升至 0.92，MAP@100 从 0.19 提升至 0.90。
  - **整体 tagging 质量**：在三个评估组中，基于召回加权 F2 指标报告了端到端的多标签标记质量，并通过消融实验验证了各策略及 RRF 融合的有效性。
- **对比优势**：与之前的列类型注释工作和商业敏感性扫描器相比，Glyph 的优势在于其不依赖数据值采样、基于代码溯源、提供每标签来源证明以及作为生产服务的可操作性。

#### 总结
Glyph 成功解决了一个大规模企业数据目录中的实际痛点，通过多智能体协作和混合策略（代码检索+多路召回融合），在保证隐私（无值处理）的前提下，实现了高精度、可审计且可扩展的自动化数据文档化和分类。该系统已在 Apple 的生产环境中验证，证明了 LLM 智能体系统在复杂企业数据治理任务中的可行性和优越性。
items.summary_en:
## 1. What the Paper Did
- **Background**: Enterprise data lakes accumulate tables faster than human stewards can document or classify them, resulting in missing column descriptions and unassigned governance labels. This "documentation debt" undermines data discovery, access control, and regulatory compliance.
- **Limitations of Existing Work**: Manual annotation is economically infeasible at scale (millions of columns). Existing automated solutions are often tied to single storage engines and cannot handle heterogeneous backends (e.g., Iceberg, RDBMS, Cassandra). Commercial scanners typically rely on data value sampling or regexes, lacking understanding of data generation logic and failing to provide auditable provenance.

## Core Contributions
- **Proposed Glyph**, a production-grade multi-strategy agentic system that frames column description generation and data classification ontology tagging as cooperating LLM agents orchestrated by stateful graphs.
- **Challenge 1: How to accurately generate business-meaningful column descriptions without relying on sensitive data values?**
  - **Difficulty**: Directly reading data values poses privacy risks and high computational costs, while metadata alone is often insufficient.
  - **Solution**: The Descriptor agent uses a "reasoning-acting" tool loop (active Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to retrieve pipeline source code from enterprise GitHub on demand, grounding description generation in code logic for value-free, code-grounded descriptions.
- **Challenge 2: How to achieve high-precision, interpretable multi-label classification under a complex governed ontology (275 leaf nodes)?**
  - **Difficulty**: Single models struggle to balance semantic similarity, business rules, and technical metadata features, while high recall is required for compliance.
  - **Solution**: The Tagger agent runs three complementary strategies in parallel (description tagger, line-of-business regex tagger, and metadata tagger backed by a fine-tuned contrastive encoder) and fuses ranked outputs using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). A fine-tuned 6-layer MiniLM encoder significantly improved same-tag retrieval performance.

## Implementation and Evaluation
- **Implementation**: The system features a value-free, code-grounded design, provides per-tag provenance, and supports graceful degradation. A 6-layer MiniLM encoder was fine-tuned with an in-batch contrastive objective.
- **Evaluation Results**:
  - **Encoder Performance**: Compared to the stock base encoder, the fine-tuned encoder lifted same-tag retrieval NDCG@10 from 0.55 to 0.92 and MAP@100 from 0.19 to 0.90 on an in-distribution held-out split.
  - **Overall Tagging Quality**: End-to-end multi-label tagging quality was reported under a recall-weighted F2 objective across three evaluation groups, with ablation studies validating each strategy and the RRF fusion.
- **Comparison**: Unlike prior column-type-annotation work and commercial sensitivity scanners, Glyph distinguishes itself through its value-free design, code grounding, per-tag provenance, and operability as a robust production service.

#### Summary
Glyph successfully addresses a critical pain point in large-scale enterprise data catalogs. By leveraging multi-agent collaboration and hybrid strategies (code retrieval + multi-path recall fusion), it achieves high-precision, auditable, and scalable automated data documentation and classification while preserving privacy (value-free processing). Validated in Apple's production environment, the system demonstrates the feasibility and superiority of LLM agentic systems in complex enterprise data governance tasks.

items.title: TrajMark: Ownership Attribution and Segment-Level Tamper Localization for Coding-Agent Trajectories
items.abstract: Watermarking the final patch produced by a coding agent provides provenance evidence for the submitted artifact, but does not authenticate the visible process that produced it. Behavioral watermarking methods primarily provide a global detection or identifier-recovery signal, so a locally edited trajectory may retain sufficient ownership evidence without revealing which protected region has become inconsistent. To address this limitation, we propose TrajMark, a training-free, symmetric-key, visible-only trajectory watermarking framework that separates robust ownership attribution from fragile local integrity verification. Our framework consists of two complementary layers: a sparse owner layer that encodes a six-bit deployment identifier by rewriting a keyed subset of naturally occurring READ actions into masked linear equations, and a localization layer that inserts linked Q12 ordinary, group, and terminal seals to commit to protected critical-action segments. This separation allows ownership evidence to accumulate robustly across trajectories, while local modifications perturb nearby keyed commitments and expose the affected protocol region. We further provide a design-level analysis of owner recoverability, integrity collision probability, structural overhead, and localization behavior. Across three coding-agent frameworks and three LLMs, TrajMark recovers the exact owner in all evaluated clean full-watermark batches. Under exhaustive eligible single-site attacks it detects 95.5%-100% of edits, and under random single-action corruption it localizes 95.8% of modified sites to an accepted protocol region rather than to the individual action. Owner marking adds no trajectory actions; the integrity layer adds explicit read-only seals, and matched Pass@1 is 26.9% versus 26.3% for unwatermarked runs.

items.summary_cn:
## 文章做了什么
- **背景**：随着代码智能体（Coding Agents）在软件工程任务中的广泛应用，其产生的可见轨迹（包括文件读取、搜索、编辑等操作记录）成为审计和溯源的重要依据。然而，现有的水印技术主要针对最终生成的代码补丁或文本内容，无法验证产生这些结果的“过程”是否被篡改。
- **已有工作的局限**：现有的行为水印方法通常提供全局的检测信号或标识符恢复功能。如果攻击者对轨迹进行局部编辑，虽然可能保留足够的全局所有权证据，但无法揭示具体哪个受保护区域变得不一致，即缺乏细粒度的完整性验证能力。

## 文章的核心贡献点
- **提出了一个名为 TrajMark 的框架**：这是一个无需训练、基于对称密钥、仅通过可见操作实现的轨迹水印框架，旨在将鲁棒的所有权归属与脆弱的局部完整性验证分离。
- **挑战1：如何在保证所有权证据鲁棒性的同时实现细粒度篡改定位？**
  - **难点**：传统方法难以兼顾全局身份的稳健提取和局部修改的敏感检测，因为强鲁棒性往往意味着对局部变化不敏感。
  - **解决方案**：TrajMark 采用双层架构。稀疏所有者层通过将部分自然的 READ 动作重写为掩码线性方程来编码6位部署标识符，确保证据在轨迹中累积且鲁棒；定位层则插入链接的 Q12 密封（普通、组和终端密封）以承诺受保护的关键动作段，任何局部修改都会扰动附近的密钥承诺，从而暴露受影响区域。
- **挑战2：如何在不显著影响智能体性能和不增加额外动作开销的情况下嵌入水印？**
  - **难点**：嵌入水印通常会引入额外的 token 或动作，可能干扰智能体的正常执行流程或降低代码生成成功率。
  - **解决方案**：所有者标记不增加任何轨迹动作，而是利用现有的 READ 动作进行重写；完整性层仅添加显式的只读密封。实验显示，其 Pass@1 指标（26.9%）与未加水印的运行（26.3%）相当，证明了其低侵入性。

## 实现与部署，evaluation 结果，要有和相关工作对比
- **实现与部署**：TrajMark 是一个训练免费的框架，适用于多种代码智能体框架和大语言模型（LLMs）。它使用对称密钥进行加密操作，无需微调模型。
- **评估结果**：
  - **所有权恢复**：在三个代码智能体框架和三个 LLM 上，TrajMark 在所有评估的干净全水印批次中均能准确恢复确切的所有者身份。
  - **篡改检测与定位**：在穷举的单点攻击下，检测到 95.5%-100% 的编辑；在随机单动作破坏下，能将 95.8% 的修改站点定位到可接受的协议区域（而非精确到单个动作，但这已足以揭示不一致性）。
  - **性能影响**：水印对智能体性能影响极小，Pass@1 从 26.3%（无水印）微升至 26.9%（有水印）。
- **对比**：相较于仅能提供全局信号的行为水印方法，TrajMark 独特地提供了段级别的篡改检测和定位能力，同时保持了同等甚至更好的所有权归属鲁棒性。

#### 总结
TrajMark 解决了代码智能体轨迹溯源中的关键空白，即不仅验证“谁”生成了结果，还验证“过程”是否被篡改。通过分离所有权归属和完整性验证，该框架在保证全局身份识别鲁棒性的同时，实现了对局部篡改的高灵敏度检测和定位，且对智能体的执行性能几乎没有负面影响，为代码智能体的安全审计提供了强有力的工具。
items.summary_en:
## 1. What the Paper Does
- **Background**: As coding agents become prevalent in software engineering, their visible trajectories (records of actions like file reads, searches, edits) are crucial for auditing and provenance. However, existing watermarking techniques primarily protect the final generated code or text, failing to authenticate the "process" that produced these results.
- **Limitations of Existing Work**: Current behavioral watermarking methods typically provide global detection signals or identifier recovery. If an attacker locally edits a trajectory, sufficient global ownership evidence may remain, but the specific inconsistent protected region is not revealed, lacking fine-grained integrity verification.

## Core Contributions
- **Proposed TrajMark**: A training-free, symmetric-key, visible-only trajectory watermarking framework that separates robust ownership attribution from fragile local integrity verification.
- **Challenge 1: How to achieve fine-grained tamper localization while maintaining robust ownership evidence?**
  - **Difficulty**: Traditional methods struggle to balance robust global identity extraction with sensitive local modification detection, as high robustness often implies insensitivity to local changes.
  - **Solution**: TrajMark uses a two-layer architecture. The sparse owner layer encodes a 6-bit deployment ID by rewriting selected natural READ actions into masked linear equations, ensuring robust evidence accumulation. The localization layer inserts linked Q12 seals (ordinary, group, terminal) to commit to protected critical action segments, where local modifications perturb nearby key commitments, exposing the affected area.
- **Challenge 2: How to embed watermarks without significantly impacting agent performance or adding action overhead?**
  - **Difficulty**: Embedding watermarks often introduces extra tokens or actions, potentially interfering with the agent's execution flow or reducing code generation success rates.
  - **Solution**: Owner marking adds no new trajectory actions by rewriting existing READ actions; the integrity layer adds only explicit read-only seals. Experiments show comparable Pass@1 scores (26.9% with watermark vs. 26.3% without), demonstrating low intrusiveness.

## Implementation and Evaluation
- **Implementation & Deployment**: TrajMark is a training-free framework compatible with various coding agent frameworks and LLMs, using symmetric keys for cryptographic operations without model fine-tuning.
- **Evaluation Results**:
  - **Ownership Recovery**: Accurately recovered the exact owner in all evaluated clean full-watermark batches across three coding agent frameworks and three LLMs.
  - **Tamper Detection & Localization**: Detected 95.5%-100% of edits under exhaustive single-site attacks; localized 95.8% of modified sites to an accepted protocol region under random single-action corruption.
  - **Performance Impact**: Minimal impact on agent performance, with Pass@1 slightly increasing from 26.3% (no watermark) to 26.9% (with watermark).
- **Comparison**: Unlike behavioral watermarking methods that only provide global signals, TrajMark uniquely offers segment-level tamper detection and localization while maintaining equal or better robustness in ownership attribution.

## 4. Conclusion
TrajMark addresses a critical gap in coding agent trajectory provenance by verifying not just "who" generated the result, but also whether the "process" was tampered with. By separating ownership attribution from integrity verification, the framework achieves high-sensitivity detection and localization of local tampering while ensuring robust global identity recognition, with negligible impact on agent performance, providing a powerful tool for secure auditing of coding agents.

items.title: TRACE: Training Reasoning Agents for Causal Exploration with Synthesized Rewards
items.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has advanced language-model reasoning in domains such as mathematics and code, where objective answers are inexpensive to check. Diagnostic reasoning over complex data lacks this advantage: establishing the true cause of an anomaly often requires costly expert investigation and may remain ambiguous after the fact. We ask whether this asymmetry of verification can instead be engineered. We sample an intervention, inject it into a controlled simulator, and generate the observations it would produce. The hidden intervention provides an oracle label and objective reward, while the agent must still investigate noisy, confounded, and distributed evidence. We instantiate this approach in TRACE, a digital-advertising diagnostic environment with 12 root causes and fine-grained segment attribution. Agents investigate each episode using Python and SQL and must identify both the root cause and, when applicable, the affected segment assignment. On a held-out 235-episode test set, the strongest prompted baseline, Claude Opus 5, reaches 0.686 FullAttr@1. Supervised fine-tuning raises Qwen3.5-35B-A3B from 0.159 to 0.637, and subsequent RL with synthesized rewards reaches 0.757, outperforming all evaluated prompted baselines, including frontier closed-source models and a prompted Qwen3.5-122B-A10B model. The resulting policy also uses substantially fewer tool calls than the prompted 35B base. These results provide evidence that access to a scalable, objective training signal can be a more important constraint than model scale alone. More broadly, simulation-based verification can make otherwise ambiguous diagnostic reasoning tasks amenable to scalable reinforcement learning.
items.summary_cn:
## 文章做了什么
- **背景**：带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在数学和代码等具有客观答案且易于验证的领域取得了显著进展。然而，复杂数据上的诊断推理缺乏这种优势，因为确定异常的真正原因通常需要昂贵的专家调查，且事后可能仍存在歧义。
- **已有的工作为什么解决不了**：现有的LLM-as-judge方法无法消除瓶颈，因为目标本身具有模糊性，而学习到的评判模型容易引入奖励黑客（reward hacking）问题。应用RLVR的主要障碍在于缺乏可扩展的、客观的地面真值（ground truth）。

## 文章的核心贡献点
- **提出了一个 TRACE 框架**：一种通过合成奖励训练因果探索推理智能体的方法，利用模拟器工程化地构建验证不对称性。
- **挑战1：诊断任务中缺乏客观且低成本的真值标签**。难点在于真实世界中的因果关系往往模糊且验证成本高。解决方法是通过采样干预措施并注入受控模拟器来生成观测数据，隐藏的干预措施作为Oracle标签提供客观奖励，从而将解决诊断任务的难度与验证答案的难度分离。
- **挑战2：在噪声和混淆证据中进行多步推理和工具使用**。难点在于智能体需要从分布式且嘈杂的数据中识别根本原因。解决方法是在TRACE数字广告诊断环境中，让智能体使用Python和SQL进行迭代调查，并通过RL优化策略，使其能够准确归因根因及受影响的分段。

## 实现与部署，evaluation 结果，要有和相关工作对比
- **环境实现**：TRACE是一个数字广告诊断环境，包含12种根本原因和细粒度的分段归因。智能体通过Python和SQL工具与多表数据库交互。
- **评估结果**：在235个episode的保留测试集上，最强的提示基线模型 Claude Opus 5 的 FullAttr@1 得分为 0.686。经过监督微调（SFT），Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 从 0.159 提升至 0.637。随后使用合成奖励进行强化学习（RL），得分进一步提升至 0.757。
- **对比分析**：TRACE训练出的策略优于所有评估过的提示基线，包括前沿的闭源模型以及提示版的 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 模型。此外，该策略使用的工具调用次数远少于提示版的35B基线模型，证明了可扩展的客观训练信号比单纯的模型规模更重要。

#### 总结
本文证明了通过基于模拟的验证机制，可以将原本模糊的诊断推理任务转化为适合可扩展强化学习的形式。TRACE框架通过工程化手段构建了验证不对称性，使得中等规模的模型在经过RL训练后，能够在复杂的因果探索任务上超越更大规模的闭源模型，同时提高了推理效率。

## 1. What the Paper Did
- **Background**: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has advanced LLM reasoning in domains like math and code where answers are easily verified. However, diagnostic reasoning over complex data lacks this advantage, as establishing true causes often requires costly expert investigation and remains ambiguous.
- **Why Existing Work Fails**: Current LLM-as-judge approaches do not resolve the ambiguity of the target itself and are prone to reward hacking. The central obstacle to applying RLVR in diagnostic settings is the lack of scalable, objective ground truth.

## Core Contributions
- **Proposed TRACE**: A framework for Training Reasoning Agents for Causal Exploration using synthesized rewards, engineering verification asymmetry via simulation.
- **Challenge 1: Lack of objective, low-cost ground truth in diagnostic tasks**. Difficulty arises from the ambiguity and high cost of verifying real-world causality. The method solves this by sampling interventions, injecting them into a controlled simulator to generate observations, and using the hidden intervention as an oracle label for deterministic verification.
- **Challenge 2: Multi-step reasoning and tool use amidst noisy, confounded evidence**. Difficulty lies in identifying root causes from distributed, noisy data. The method addresses this by deploying agents in the TRACE digital advertising environment, using Python and SQL for iterative investigation, and optimizing policies via RL to accurately attribute root causes and affected segments.

## Implementation and Evaluation
- **Implementation**: TRACE is a digital advertising diagnostic environment with 12 root causes and fine-grained segment attribution. Agents interact with multi-table databases using Python and SQL.
- **Results**: On a held-out test set of 235 episodes, the strongest prompted baseline, Claude Opus 5, achieved a FullAttr@1 score of 0.686. Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) raised Qwen3.5-35B-A3B from 0.159 to 0.637. Subsequent RL with synthesized rewards further improved the score to 0.757.
- **Comparison**: The TRACE-trained policy outperformed all evaluated prompted baselines, including frontier closed-source models and the prompted Qwen3.5-122B-A10B model. It also used substantially fewer tool calls than the prompted 35B base, demonstrating that access to scalable, objective training signals can be more critical than model scale alone.

## 4. Conclusion
This paper demonstrates that simulation-based verification can make ambiguous diagnostic reasoning tasks amenable to scalable reinforcement learning. By engineering verification asymmetry, the TRACE framework enables medium-sized models to surpass larger closed-source models in complex causal exploration tasks while improving inference efficiency.
